english.title: Cab driver plying for hire failed to display badge number, licensed area or other notice on cab
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a cab-driver, failed to affix to the cab operated when plying for hire

(A)_[the display of your badge number and licensed area in the form thought fit]_
(B)_[a notice or mark, namely **(..SPECIFY NOTICE OR MARK..), as directed]_

by Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to article 28A of the London Cab Order 1934 and section 10 of the Metropolitan Carriage Act 1869.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a cab-driver, failed to affix to the cab operated when plying for hire

(A)_[the display of his badge number and licensed area in the form thought fit]_
(B)_[the display of her badge number and licensed area in the form thought fit]_
(C)_[a notice or mark, namely **(..SPECIFY NOTICE OR MARK..), as directed]_

by Transport for London.
